title: service-settings: the Setup settings pages say 「工作区名称」 and 「此工作区」 for the organisation or environment — use the ruled nouns (ruling cloud#2939 A)
body:
Filing gate: **③ a task the maintainer directed.** The maintainer ruled objectstack-ai/cloud#2939 letter A, 「同意」 2026-10-17 (ruling `6229029648`): one noun, 「组织」, for the thing members and billing belong to, and 「环境」 for the running instance. 「工作区」 retires. The ruling names this card as one of three follow-ups. Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim. Independent: no `Blocked-by`.
Dedupe: the 200 most recent open objectstack issues carry no card on `service-settings` translations or `workspace_name`.

## Where (framework pin `f7e836da1ed3`; re-read on `main`)

cloud's control plane mounts the framework `SettingsServicePlugin` with `builtinSettingsManifests` (cloud `packages/service-cloud/src/control-plane-preset.ts:355`). Its Setup settings pages read:
- 「工作区名称」 (Branding);
- 「此工作区」 in the mail, SMS and feature-flag descriptions.

The strings live in:
- `packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/zh-CN.ts:23,63,103,109,129,274,394`;
- `en.ts:27,67,73,93,161,205`;
- `ja-JP.ts:23,63,69,132,254,295,329`;
- `es-ES.ts:23,63,69,132,254,295,329`;
- the en source in `manifests/branding.manifest.ts:5,11,15,19` and the mail, SMS, feature-flags, localization, company and auth manifests.

## Done when

- **Each string names what it means:** the organisation (组织 / Organization) on the control plane's settings, or the environment (环境 / Environment) where a tenant reads it.
- **The four locales follow.**
- **A test pins** that no settings manifest or bundle says workspace / 工作区.

If one manifest is read on both planes with different meanings, say so and pick the wording per plane through the existing manifest scope, or report it.

Dedupe words: service-settings workspace_name 工作区名称 branding settings; settings manifests workspace noun.
